title: Verified original attachment
structural: Safe structural view of the verified original file. Original styling, scripts and navigation are omitted; CSS-generated content and publisher pagination are not reproduced.
source: Exact decoded original source. Tags, attributes, whitespace and Unicode are preserved as text; this is not an HTML rendering.
plain: Exact decoded original file text, verified against the cited extraction.
excerpt: Extracted text and exact cited excerpt
excerptHelp: The marked excerpt and character offsets below refer only to the immutable extraction. No highlight, physical page or EPUB CFI is assigned to the structural view.
precision: Resource-level location; no position within the rendered resource is claimed.
incomplete: This structural representation has omissions. Inspect each limitation and the original source; it is not a complete reproduction.
